title: Data
subtitle: Unified access to databases, stickers and other business data

db.selectTable: Select a table on the left to browse
db.deleteConfirm: Delete row #{{rowid}}? This cannot be undone.
db.blobReadonly: Binary / vector columns cannot be edited online
db.queryReadonlyHint: Read-only console: single SELECT / WITH / EXPLAIN / PRAGMA statement, capped at 500 rows (⌘/Ctrl + Enter to run)
db.truncatedHint: truncated, use view for full text

conn.empty: No external connections yet. Add a PostgreSQL / MySQL read-only source.
conn.name: Name
conn.passwordHint: Password supports ${VAR} env references; leave empty or keep **** when editing to keep unchanged

storage.envWarning: ANELF_DATA_DIR ({{value}}) is set and takes precedence over the data_root config; migration would have no effect. Remove the env var first.
storage.restartHint: Migration finished and data_root written ({{target}}). The new directory takes effect after restart; the source directory is kept and can be removed manually once verified.
storage.errorHint: Migration failed: {{error}}. Partially copied files remain in the target directory; fix and retry.

problem.not_absolute: Target must be an absolute path
problem.same_as_current: Target must differ from the current data directory
problem.inside_current: Target cannot be inside the current data directory
problem.contains_current: Target cannot contain the current data directory
problem.not_a_directory: Target exists and is not a directory

warning.not_empty: Target directory is not empty; conflicting files will be overwritten

storage.migrateHint: SQLite files are copied via online backup (safe while running); the source directory is kept. Restart required afterwards.

volumes.subtitle: Each data module managed independently: backup / restore / relocate / external SQL transfer
volumes.needsRestart: Location switched; applies after restart. New writes before restart still go to the old location.

backupDrawer.title: {{name}} · Backups
backupDrawer.restoreConfirmBody: Current data is kept as a .pre-restore safety copy. The restore applies after restart; writes made before restarting are lost.

relocate.title: Relocate {{name}}
relocate.hint: Move this volume to another directory or disk: online copy (cognee tree waits for a sync idle window) → write location config → restart to apply. Source files are kept.

problem.target_file_exists: A data file with the same name already exists in the target directory

sql.noConnections: No external connections configured (add a PostgreSQL / MySQL connection in the database tab)
sql.exportHint: Schema and data are pushed in full to the external database as a backup slot or transfer channel. Derived indexes (FTS/vector) are not transferred and can be imported back anytime.
sql.importHint: Only databases produced by this system's export are accepted. Import builds a fresh database and applies after restart; current data is kept as a safety copy.
